case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the central location, cleanliness and new, well‑equipped rooms (microwave, fridge, coffee capsule machine, minibar) and comfortable beds in several reviews. Reported negatives included absence of an on‑site reception and in‑house breakfast (breakfast often served next door), occasional poor breakfast value, inability to store luggage after checkout, a few comments about a hard mattress, exterior appearance and less desirable room views.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.area: Front‑desk / Guest services (reception, staff availability, luggage storage, late check-out)
priorities.recommendation: Implement on‑call/remote check‑in, luggage storage policy, partner SLA if needed, SOP and staff training.
Short-term review breakfast partner agreement; negotiate or consider in-house if commercially viable, communicate pre-arrival/check-in details.

priorities.area: Pre‑stay and on‑property communication / listing accuracy
priorities.recommendation: In communications, state no reception, check-in, breakfast, luggage, emergency; add photos and FAQ for older/accessibility
Assess sleeping surfaces, outlets, and bedside storage; commission audit, document temporary mitigations, evaluate long-term needs.
Inspect affected rooms' plumbing/drains immediately, identify/rectify smell; audit ventilation, housekeeping, schedule follow-up if intermittent/systemic.
Update public channels stating unstaffed reception and breakfast; review procedures, remind on-call staff, evaluate signage.
